items.title: Junior Mance Part II interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 18, 1999 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: remember when Oscar Pettiford made those records playing jazz cello?

ctx.x: Do you ever get any string players in the class?

I had a jazz cello player last semester, from Italy, who was fantastic. Like his idol was, remember when Oscar Pettiford made those records playing jazz cello? And he played like that, but he loves the blues. And he’s coming back. And he’s also a wonderful bass player too so he’s going to come back doubling. He’s the only string player, unless you want to call a guitar player. That’s another one I had to weed out because I was getting six and seven guitar players every semester, so I told them no more than two…
Do you memorize some heads with them?
